budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Use complementary specialist production and local escrow trades to complete shared machines, or take immediate private component-sale rewards.
task.natural_termination: Completion of two shared machines ends the game; otherwise truncate at 96 steps. Finite raw supply can be consumed by private sales, leaving shared completion impossible within that trajectory.
task.interaction: A posted offer removes a real component into escrow; an adjacent controlled buyer pays a real price and receives that item. Scarce gathering, rotating settlement priority, expiring reservations and four-way complementary assembly change peers resources and recipes.
task.observation_access: All inventories, reservations, stock, jobs, contributions and spatial positions are public. Own-role one-hot precedes the public vector. Immutable tool assignment, station/pile locations and topology are known rules. Colocation is permitted for physical exchange at a common workshop tile; only Manhattan-distance-one handoffs settle.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Seller index for each successful buyer in this step, -1 for no settlement.
Per-step expired unsold offers whose reserved component is returned.
Per-step workstation completions; shelf stock is a separate persistent level.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
